title: What Is an Ecosystem?
summary: Living (biotic) and non-living (abiotic) parts; producers, consumers and decomposers; and the cycles that recycle nutrients.

ib.note: Nutrient cycles are studied in depth in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: How Nature Works in Harmony

objectives: I can identify biotic and abiotic components of an ecosystem.
I can classify organisms as producers, consumers or decomposers.
I can explain why decomposers are essential.
misconceptions: An ecosystem is only the animals in a place.
Plants get their food from the soil.
